summary: TORONTO, Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Barrick Mining Corporation (NYSE:B)(TSX:ABX) (“Barrick” or the “Company”) today announced that its planned new publicly listed company, which will hold Barrick's North American gold assets, will be named American Barrick Gold Corporation (“American Barrick”). The Company is moving forward with the proposed initial public offering (“IPO”) of American Barrick common stock.
title: Barrick Announces American Barrick and S-1 Filing for Proposed Initial Public Offering
